content.short: Michigan Blockchain provides association aims to promote and advance blockchain and its applications.
content.description: Michigan Blockchain is a hub for students at the University of Michigan and organizations interested in blockchain technology. It seeks to educate, connect, and empower participants by promoting collaboration and innovation in the blockchain space. The group organizes events, shares resources, and provides opportunities for members to explore blockchain solutions. University of Michigan students can use the platform to learn about blockchain and connect with others in the industry to create new, real-world blockchain applications.
